pages.title: Statistical Mechanics
pages.text: $(thing)Statistical Mechanics$()$(br2)Temperature, pressure and entropy are averages over states too many to count: each weighted by e^(−E/kT). Sum the weights and the partition function holds every property of the system.

$(thing)Insight$(): 140$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Stochastic Processes, Thermodynamics of Information.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Markov Chain Link, 1 Avogadro Record.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Two states differ in energy by E. At temperature T, write the ratio r of how often the upper one is found to how often the lower one is, with Boltzmann's k.
